findings.title: "Covered pending row must remain visible" needs scoping to the custody scan, not the recovery admission scan
findings.evidence: Lines 95782-95784 pre-commit D.110c-0c1 to keep a covered `pending` row 'visible to existing offline/rebase custody'. Both the recovery scan and the rebase scan read through the same wrapped view: recoverV3LiveReplica pages packages/node/src/v3-live.ts:5040-5098 and readRebaseOutbox pages v3-live.ts:6025 via `registration.issuanceStore`, which is the creatorFilteredIssuanceStore instance built at v3-live.ts:7377-7427. If a covered pending old row is returned unchanged to the recovery page, classifyPlaneVertex yields neither `current` nor `displaced` and v3-live.ts:5097-5098 returns admission-rejected — the exact demonstrated failure. The code already builds distinct filtered views per consumer, so a per-view treatment is implementable.
findings.required_action: Disposition (owned by D.110c-0c1, no 0c1a change): amend 95782-95784 to scope 'visible' to the offline/rebase custody and publication scans, and state that the recovery admission scan must give a covered pending row an authenticated old-address classification rather than returning it to the unmodified current/displaced predicate.

findings.title: "Returns the original accepted proposal" must not undo the existing stage-mode retiring-ref filtering
findings.evidence: Lines 95827-95829 and item 4 at 95867-95868 say the wrapper 'removes those exact candidates ... then returns the original accepted proposal'. The existing wrapper already performs a second, unrelated normalization in stage mode: packages/node/src/internal/creator-transition-advance.ts:94-102 filters the three retiring epoch-N-1 cut/QC/ACL refs out of the proposal, and packages/node/src/creator-close.ts:593 stages `advance.proposed.closure`. A literal 'original proposal' would restore those retiring refs into the staged closure, breaking the bounded-closure law that inspectBoundedCreatorTrustAdvance enforces at the next epoch (creator-trust-checkpoint-advance.ts:208). The text also says 'candidates' where both the ref and its candidate must be stripped, since inspectTrustClosure rejects a closure ref without a candidate ('candidate-missing', anchor-trust.ts:393-396).
findings.required_action: Disposition: state at 95827-95829 that the wrapper strips the matching ref and candidate pair, preserves the existing stage-mode retiring-ref filtering unchanged, and returns that accepted proposal with only the retirement delta restored; the retained 0b0/0b1 bounded-closure suite is the gate.

findings.title: A permanent admitted-graph hole freezes the frontier for all later epochs; state the invariant and owner
findings.evidence: Lines 95756-95758 truncate at an issued-but-unadmitted address and refuse on a later admitted address after a nonmember. Because coverage also requires 'exact current room/anchor/epoch' (95747), an address that misses its own close graph can never be covered at any later close, so the dense prefix stops below it permanently and every subsequent epoch's rows stay uncovered — the frontier freezes rather than one row sticking. The window exists in principle between the graph capture at packages/node/src/creator-close.ts:487 and terminalization at :604; it heals in the ordinary case because restart recovery re-admits durable outbox rows into the same epoch's plane before its close.
findings.required_action: Disposition: record at 95756-95758 that a permanent hole freezes the frontier and later reopen stays fail-closed, and state the relied-on invariant — durable issuance cannot interleave with close-graph capture on the product path — naming the RED/GREEN 'issued-but-unadmitted suffix' row as its evidence; if that invariant does not hold, this becomes a reslice trigger rather than a 0c1a widening.

findings.title: Per-row durable-replay membership is not directly observable; name the exact discharge for the asserted RED
findings.evidence: Lines 95844-95847 require the RED to assert 'graph membership, durable-replay membership'. Graph membership is assertable with no production change because deriveCloseSetHistoryCommitment is exported (packages/compaction/src/index.ts:14) and the cut-value blob carrying closeSetRoot/closeSetCount/snapshotManifestDigest is readable from the AHE by the returned cutValueRef (creator-close.ts:387-410, 570). The sealed durable replay, however, exposes only `verify(): Promise<boolean>` (v3-live.ts:392, creator-close.ts:136), so per-row replay membership has no observable product surface, and RED may add no production export.
findings.required_action: Disposition: qualify 95845-95847 so durable-replay membership is discharged as the sealed-replay verification result plus exact per-row issued/outbox byte equality and the independently recomputed close-set commitment, keeping RED tests-only with no new export.
